title: Promotion Exam: Score Calculation
description: A dan promotion exam with no yaku or fu shown: answer the score of any riichi mahjong hand. Pinfu, chiitoitsu, open hands and mangan and above all appear. You can make at most one mistake
questionPrompt: Answer the score for this win
koTsumoScore: Score (from each non-dealer / from the dealer)

howToPlay.title: Question format
howToPlay.lead: You will get every kind of winning hand. Neither the yaku nor the fu are shown, so build up the fu yourself, count the han and answer the score. Pinfu, chiitoitsu, open hands and mangan and above all appear, so the range is not narrowed down.
